QuestInfo.name: Find Legendary Coin Cakes!
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra says that if you find a lucky coin in your Lucky Cake, you'll have good luck all year long.
QuestInfo.1: If you bring her Legendary Coin Cakes, Cassandra will give you a gift.
QuestInfo.2: Bring Cassandra a Legendary Coin Cake with a lucky coin in it for New Year's luck. Enjoy Legends!

0.0: Welcome to the party! If there's anything you need, feel free to let me know! I'm happy to help!
0.1: Oh, and I've got a special gift for you! If you find a Legendary Coin Cake, you'll get all kinds of luck on New Year's Day!
0.2: So, would you like to look for a Legendary Coin Cake?

yes.0:
If you stumble upon any Legendary Coin Cakes, 
I'll give you some extra luck. Don't miss this chance for some extra gifts!
It's a little way to make Legends even more fun! 
Just so you know, Legendary Coin Cakes are pretty rare. You'll need to look hard to find even one! Well, have fun!

no.0: Of course, of course. As long as you're having fun, I'm happy.

1.0:
Wow, I'm impressed! 
You found the Legendary Coin Cake.
I'm so proud of you. Great work! 
As promised, here is your gift of New Year's luck.

item.0: Still working on those Legendary Coin Cakes? Don't worry! I know you'll get me 1 of them in no time!

yes.0:
If you find more Legendary Coin Cakes and bring them to me, then good things will happen to you throughout the year.
Have fun playing Legends!
